note: Objectively-scorable build tasks. Each is a single user turn; the scorer reads the resulting conversation transcript. train = used for reflection, holdout = used only to gate an edit.

tasks.prompt: Build a simple counter app with plus and minus buttons and a reset. Clean minimal design.
Build a tip calculator: enter a bill amount and tip percent, show the tip and total updating live. Modern clean design.
Build a mood tracker: log a daily mood with an emoji and see a 7-day history. Calm, soft design.
Build a to-do list app: add a task, check it off, and delete it. Persist locally. Simple design.
Build a color palette generator: show five random hex color swatches, click one to copy it, and a button to regenerate. Nice modern design.
Build a flashcards app: show a question, tap to flip to the answer, and next/previous buttons to move through a small deck. Clean design.
